description: Log-normal vs Weibull AFT distribution comparison (72-combo subset, 700 Nm)
note: The comparison uses a 72-combo subset (Miner_original only) with full factorial design matrix (10 beta parameters + 1 sigma). The log-normal distribution is retained for the main analysis because (i) log10(Nf) is the natural scale for Basquin-type S-N comparisons and (ii) the likelihood-ratio decomposition under log-normality is equivalent to Sobol first-order indices for balanced factorial designs.
